# test intelligence

@claude-flow/plugin-test-intelligence

## 中文说明

Test Intelligence 是 Claude Code 的能力扩展，用来处理对应领域里的文件、网页、数据或自动化流程。

## 典型场景
- 使用 Test Intelligence 完成相关任务
- 减少手工复制、整理和重复操作
- 把固定流程交给 Claude Code 执行

{
  "compilerOptions": {
    "target": "ES2022",
    "module": "NodeNext",
    "moduleResolution": "NodeNext",
    "lib": ["ES2022"],
    "outDir": "./dist",
    "rootDir": "./src",
    "strict": true,
    "esModuleInterop": true,
    "skipLibCheck": true,
    "forceConsistentCasingInFileNames": true,
    "declaration": true,
    "declarationMap": true,
    "sourceMap": true,
    "noUnusedLocals": true,
    "noUnusedParameters": true,
    "noImplicitReturns": true,
    "noFallthroughCasesInSwitch": true,
    "resolveJsonModule": true,
    "isolatedModules": true
  },
  "include": ["src/**/*"],
  "exclude": ["node_modules", "dist", "**/*.test.ts"]
}
